arguments.summary: The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing all week. The read replica is 12 minutes behind. The primary database query shows 1204 failed jobs. The backlog needs to be addressed to ensure jobs are not failing due to system issues.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Start investigating the root cause of the failed jobs, focusing on any recent changes or system updates. Once identified, implement a fix and update the failed_jobs table. Schedule a retro for Friday to discuss the issue and share findings.
